scope: backend component only; local synthetic databases; no deployment

concurrent_contracts: two workers publish one due occurrence
two workers publish one status run
pause and publication have one serialized outcome
two creators cannot exceed account rule budget
concurrent stale status saves capture one transition

verified_behaviors: three strict rule kinds; initially paused; explicit activation consent
own account and exact assignment only; no owner bypass for other rules or private channels
current permissions, credentials, pilot and source rechecked for each action
MFA presence is not converted into permanent unattended authority
status changes are queued transactionally without source-title snapshots or task writes
one-off and fixed-UTC recurring reminders; missed intervals do not flood the channel
independent recurring page from a pinned same-channel template version
effects and receipts commit or roll back together
bounded retry preserves occurrence; late failures cannot undo newer success
full quota allows existing reservations to finish and an idempotent manual stop
current task projections redact revoked references in run history
configurable record/rule budgets; no history deletion to make room
status fanout counts capacity once per batch and reserves only remaining slots
